description: §5: standing consent is exactly the owner-approved permission set, cadence and lifetime at pairing or scope upgrade. Per-item consent is the existing policy and human-request flow. The gateway and the host never approve.

steps.does: approves native_work with the permissions receive_agent_messages, send_agent_messages, execute_cases, a cadence and a lifetime; re-approves at every 7-day re-pairing

the old session is refused; the host re-pairs through the unchanged Stage 1 route and the owner confirms the repair for this exact installation (comparison phrase, current assurance), which issues the generation-5 cookie
replies that current policy allows are sent under that standing grant
a reply that policy says needs a human decision opens the existing human request; nothing is sent until the owner decides in the dashboard
a later reply on the next tick is governed by the decision as the case policy binds it (exact case, recipient, content and generation); a changed detail needs a fresh decision
